description: This file defines the OptionsChainsProperties class, which provides a comprehensive interface for analyzing options chain data, including calculating metrics like greeks, spreads, strategies, and filtering data for option analysis within a larger trading or options analysis project.

classes.name: OptionsChainsProperties
classes.description: A base class for options chain data providing calculation and filtering methods for options analytics.

methods.name: last_price(self)
methods.description: Property to get or set the manually specified underlying asset price.

methods.name: "DataFrame" dataframe(self)
methods.description: Returns all options data as a pandas DataFrame, including computed columns such as breakeven, GEX, DEX.

methods.name: List[str] expirations(self)
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique expiration dates from the options data.

methods.name: List[float] strikes(self)
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique strike prices from the options data.

methods.name: bool has_iv(self)
methods.description: Boolean indicating if implied volatility data is present.

methods.name: bool has_greeks(self)
methods.description: Boolean indicating if Greek metrics are present in the data.

methods.name: Dict total_oi(self)
methods.description: Provides aggregated open interest statistics across options.

methods.name: Dict total_volume(self)
methods.description: Provides aggregated volume statistics across options.

methods.name: Dict total_dex(self)
methods.description: Returns total delta dollars (DAX) for options if Greeks are available.

methods.name: Dict total_gex(self)
methods.description: Returns total gamma exposure (GEX) for options if Greeks are available.

methods.name: str _identify_price_col( df: "DataFrame", option_type: Literal["call", "put"], bid_ask: Literal["bid", "ask"], )
methods.description: Utility method to determine the correct bid or ask price column name for options data.

methods.name: "DataFrame" filter_data( self, date: Optional[Union[str, int]] = None, option_type: Optional[Literal["call", "put"]] = None, moneyness: Optional[Literal["otm", "itm"]] = None, column: Optional[str] = None, value_min: Optional[float] = None, value_max: Optional[float] = None, stat: Optional[Literal["open_interest", "volume", "dex", "gex"]] = None, by: Literal["expiration", "strike"] = "expiration", )
methods.description: Filters options data based on date, option type, moneyness, specific column values, and statistical metrics.

methods.name: Dict _get_stat( self, metric: Literal["open_interest", "volume", "DEX", "GEX"], moneyness: Optional[Literal["otm", "itm"]] = None, date: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates aggregate statistics such as open interest, volume, DEX, GEX for options data.

methods.name: str _get_nearest_expiration( self, date: Optional[Union[str, int]] = None, df: Optional["DataFrame"] = None )
methods.description: Finds the nearest expiration date based on a target date or days until expiry.

methods.name: Dict _get_nearest_otm_strikes( self, date: Optional[Union[str, int]] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, moneyness: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Returns nearest out-of-the-money call and put strikes at a given percent OTM.

methods.name: Union[float,None] _get_nearest_strike( self, option_type: Literal["call", "put"], days: Optional[Union[int, str]] = None, strike: Optional[float] = None, price_col: Optional[str] = None, force_otm: bool = True, )
methods.description: Finds the nearest strike for a given option type, days to expiry, and target price.

methods.name: "DataFrame" straddle( self, days: Optional[int] = None, strike: Optional[float] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the combined cost of a straddle position for a given expiry DTE and strike.

methods.name: "DataFrame" strangle( self, days: Optional[int] = None, moneyness: Optional[float] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a strangle position based on DTE and % moneyness.

methods.name: "DataFrame" vertical_call_spread( self, days: Optional[int] = None, sold: Optional[float] = None, bought: Optional[float] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Computes a vertical call spread for specified DTE and strikes.

methods.name: "DataFrame" vertical_put_spread( self, days: Optional[int] = None, sold: Optional[float] = None, bought: Optional[float] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Computes a vertical put spread for specified DTE and strikes.

methods.name: "DataFrame" synthetic_long( self, days: Optional[int] = 30, strike: float = 0, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost and parameters of a synthetic long position using call and put options.

methods.name: "DataFrame" synthetic_short( self, days: Optional[int] = None, strike: float = 0, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost and parameters of a synthetic short position.

methods.name: "DataFrame" strategies( self, days: Optional[List] = None, straddle_strike: Optional[float] = None, strangle_moneyness: Optional[List[float]] = None, synthetic_longs: Optional[List[float]] = None, synthetic_shorts: Optional[List[float]] = None, vertical_calls: Optional[List[tuple]] = None, vertical_puts: Optional[List[tuple]] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Generates multiple options strategies (straddles, strangles, spreads, synthetic longs/shorts) across different expirations and moneyness levels.

methods.name: "DataFrame" skew( self, date: Optional[Union[str, int]] = None, moneyness: Optional[float] = None, underlying_price: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Analyzes options skewness for a given date, moneyness, or underlying price.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Calculates the skewness of options data, either vertical or horizontal, based on implied volatility differences at various strikes or expirations, with parameters for date, moneyness, and underlying price.
